title: First Bassline
intro: The oldest trick in techno: the bass plays where the kick isn't. Your kick owns beats 1, 2, 3 and 4, so put a bass note in each gap — steps 3, 7, 11 and 15 on the Bass Line row. Four notes, all on the same pitch for now. Press play: the kick and the bass hand off to each other instead of fighting for the low end.
